senses.definition: a question or a short text with a hidden meaning that you have to guess

examples.text: My grandfather loved telling riddles.
Can you guess the answer to this riddle?

senses.definition: to breathe in suddenly and loudly because you are surprised, shocked or in pain

examples.text: Everyone gasped when the lights went off.
She gasped at the beautiful view.
examples.translation: Gözəl mənzərəni görəndə onun nəfəsi kəsildi.

senses.definition: a short, loud breath because of surprise or pain

examples.text: There was a gasp from the audience.
With a gasp, he dropped his cup.
examples.translation: O, qəfildən nəfəsini içinə çəkib fincanı yerə saldı.

senses.definition: your name written in your own special way, for example at the end of a letter

examples.text: Please put your signature at the bottom of the page.
examples.translation: Zəhmət olmasa, səhifənin aşağısında imzanızı qoyun.

examples.text: I can't read the signature on this letter.

senses.definition: having lost its color or brightness over time

examples.text: He was wearing faded blue jeans.
examples.translation: Onun əynində rəngi solmuş göy cins şalvar var idi.

examples.text: The old photo was faded and yellow.
examples.translation: Köhnə şəkil solğun və saralmış idi.

senses.definition: a border made of wood, metal or plastic around a picture, a door or a window

examples.text: She put our wedding photo in a silver frame.
examples.translation: O, toy şəklimizi gümüşü çərçivəyə qoydu.

examples.text: The window frame is old and needs paint.

senses.definition: to take letters, packages or goods to a person or a place

examples.text: The pizza was delivered in twenty minutes.
Who delivers the mail on your street?

senses.definition: to shake slightly because you are afraid, excited, nervous or cold

examples.text: My hands were trembling before the interview.
Her voice trembled when she said goodbye.

senses.definition: according to what you have heard or read; it seems that

examples.text: Apparently, the shop is closed on Mondays.
examples.translation: Deyilənə görə, mağaza bazar ertəsi bağlıdır.

examples.text: He was apparently very angry about it.
examples.translation: Görünür, o, buna görə çox əsəbiləşmişdi.

examples.text: Is your great-grandmother still alive?
The fish was still alive when we bought it.
examples.translation: Balığı alanda o, hələ diri idi.

senses.definition: the large area just inside the entrance of a building such as a hotel or an apartment building

examples.text: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at six.
There are mailboxes in the lobby of our building.

senses.definition: not able to move, or fixed in one position

examples.text: The door is stuck. I can't open it.
We were stuck in traffic for an hour.

senses.definition: to lift something from a surface; also to collect someone in a car

examples.text: Please pick up your clothes from the floor.
I'll pick up the kids from school at four.

senses.definition: completely sure; also used for a particular thing without saying exactly which

examples.text: Are you certain that you locked the door?
The museum is free on certain days.

senses.definition: a box where letters are delivered to your home, or where you put letters to send them

examples.text: I check my mailbox every evening.
There was a postcard in the mailbox.
examples.translation: Poçt qutusunda bir açıqca var idi.

senses.definition: to open something that was folded so that it becomes flat

examples.text: He unfolded the map and looked for the river.
She carefully unfolded the old letter.

sentences.text: Sevda couldn't wait, so she opened the envelope right there, at Aunt Zarifa's kitchen table.
sentences.translation: Sevda səbr edə bilmədi və zərfi elə oradaca, Zərifə xalanın mətbəx masasının arxasında açdı.

sentences.text: Her hands were trembling a little as she unfolded the paper inside.
sentences.translation: İçindəki kağızı açanda əlləri bir az titrəyirdi.

sentences.text: It was a short riddle, written in old-fashioned blue ink:
sentences.translation: Bu, köhnə üslubda göy mürəkkəblə yazılmış qısa bir tapmaca idi:

sentences.text: “Find the clock that never moves, and the door will open.”
sentences.translation: “Heç vaxt tərpənməyən saatı tap, qapı açılacaq.”

sentences.text: At the bottom, there was a signature: just one letter, “B.”
sentences.translation: Aşağıda bir imza var idi: cəmi bir hərf – “B.”

sentences.text: She picked up an old photo in a wooden frame from the shelf and turned it over.
sentences.translation: O, rəfdən taxta çərçivədə olan köhnə bir şəkli götürüb arxasını çevirdi.

sentences.text: On the back, in faded ink, there was the same handwriting: “To Zarifa, from B.”
sentences.translation: Arxa tərəfdə solğun mürəkkəblə eyni xətlə yazılmışdı: “Zərifəyə, B.-dən.”

sentences.text: “It's Bahram's handwriting, I'm certain,” she whispered. “So he must still be alive!”
sentences.translation: “Bu, Bəhramın xəttidir, əminəm,” – deyə pıçıldadı. “Deməli, o, hələ sağdır!”

sentences.text: “But who delivered the envelope?” Sevda asked.
sentences.translation: “Bəs zərfi kim gətirib?” – deyə Sevda soruşdu.

sentences.text: “It was in my mailbox yesterday morning,” Aunt Zarifa said. “Apparently, someone came very early, before anyone woke up.”
sentences.translation: “Dünən səhər poçt qutumda idi,” – deyə Zərifə xala dedi. “Görünür, kimsə çox tezdən, hamı oyanmamış gəlib.”

sentences.text: Then Sevda remembered the big clock in the lobby.
sentences.translation: Sonra Sevda vestibüldəki böyük saatı xatırladı.

sentences.text: Everyone in the building walked past it every day without really looking at it.
sentences.translation: Binadakı hər kəs hər gün ona diqqətlə baxmadan yanından keçirdi.

sentences.text: Its hands had been stuck at a quarter past seven for as long as anyone could remember.
sentences.translation: Hamının yadında olduğu vaxtdan bəri onun əqrəbləri yeddini on beş dəqiqə keçəndə ilişib qalmışdı.

sentences.text: Who sent the riddle, and what is hidden behind the clock?
sentences.translation: Tapmacanı kim göndərib və saatın arxasında nə gizlənib?

glossary.lemma: for as long as anyone can remember

grammar.explanation: When who or what asks about the subject (the person or thing that does the action), we don't use do, does or did, and the verb comes right after the question word: Who delivered the envelope? (Someone delivered it.) When who or what asks about the object (the person or thing that receives the action), we use do, does or did, as in a normal question: Who did you see? (You saw someone.)
grammar.explanationTranslation: Who və ya what mübtəda haqqında soruşanda (hərəkəti edən şəxs və ya əşya), do, does, did işlədilmir və feil sual sözündən dərhal sonra gəlir: Who delivered the envelope? (Kimsə zərfi gətirib.) Who və ya what tamamlıq haqqında soruşanda (hərəkətin yönəldiyi şəxs və ya əşya), adi sualda olduğu kimi do, does, did işlədilir: Who did you see? (Sən kimisə gördün.)

rules.text: Subject question: Who/What + verb: Who wrote the note? What happened?
rules.translation: Mübtəda sualı: Who/What + feil: Who wrote the note? What happened?

rules.text: Object question: Who/What + do/does/did + subject + verb: What did the note say? Who did Sevda visit?
rules.translation: Tamamlıq sualı: Who/What + do/does/did + mübtəda + feil: What did the note say? Who did Sevda visit?

rules.text: In present simple subject questions, the verb is singular: Who lives on the fifth floor?
rules.translation: Present simple-da mübtəda suallarında feil təkdə olur: Who lives on the fifth floor?

rules.text: Compare: Who called Sevda? (someone called her) / Who did Sevda call? (she called someone)
rules.translation: Müqayisə edin: Who called Sevda? (kimsə ona zəng etdi) / Who did Sevda call? (o, kiməsə zəng etdi)

examples.text: Who delivered the envelope?
What did the riddle say?
Who lives in apartment 7?
Who did Aunt Zarifa call?
What happened to the clock in the lobby?

exercise.instructions: Choose or write the correct question form.
exercise.instructionsTranslation: Düzgün sual formasını seçin və ya yazın.

questions.prompt: Who ___ the window? It's cold in here!
questions.explanation: Who is the subject (someone opened it), so we don't use did.
questions.explanationTranslation: Who mübtədadır (kimsə açıb), ona görə did işlədilmir.

questions.promptTranslation: Bu səhər səhər yeməyində nə yedin?
questions.explanation: What is the object (you ate something), so we use did.
questions.explanationTranslation: What tamamlıqdır (sən nəsə yedin), ona görə did işlədilir.

questions.explanation: In a present simple subject question, the verb is singular: lives.
questions.explanationTranslation: Present simple-da mübtəda sualında feil təkdə olur: lives.

questions.prompt: Who ___ (call) you last night? (someone called you)
questions.promptTranslation: Dünən gecə sənə kim zəng etdi?
questions.explanation: Who is the subject, so we use the past simple without did.
questions.explanationTranslation: Who mübtədadır, ona görə did olmadan past simple işlədilir.

questions.explanation: What is the object (Sevda found something), so we use did + subject + verb.
questions.explanationTranslation: What tamamlıqdır (Sevda nəsə tapdı), ona görə did + mübtəda + feil işlədilir.
